_help: Custom blocks. Each block needs: id (anchor + optional nav), type, and type-specific fields. Reference a block from site.json sections as { "type": "block", "id": "<id>" }. Types: text | images | cards | cta | html. See AI_GUIDE.md for schemas.

paragraphs.EN: Example custom block. Delete it or edit content/blocks.json. Add it to the page by listing { "type": "block", "id": "process-notes" } in site.json → sections.
paragraphs.RU: Пример кастомного блока. Удалите его или измените content/blocks.json. Чтобы показать на странице, добавьте { "type": "block", "id": "process-notes" } в site.json → sections.

text.EN: Numbered, signed, shipped from the Russian Federation.
